text: Ismail Kadare's Përbindëshi was banned in 1965 under communist rule in Albania, and Kadare came into conflict with the regime. The regime said the book was too decadent for the country's population, but despite the ban it circulated illegally and kept its influence in the country. After the fall of communism in Albania the book became available to the public again.
meta_description: Ismail Kadare's Përbindëshi was banned under communist rule in Albania in 1965 but circulated illegally; it became available again after communism fell.
